summary: Copy one file synchronously while preserving COPYFILE_EXCL/FICLONE flags and Node failure cleanup semantics.

semantics.default: destination is overwritten if it already exists

caveats: File.Copy overwrite behavior must be selected from Node flags, not hard-coded.
Node does not guarantee atomic copy; partial destination handling on failure must follow Node behavior.

tests.name: default overwrites destination
tests.expected_behavior: b contains A after the copy

tests.name: exclusive destination
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node-compatible EEXIST-style error and does not overwrite b
